review_reference: Backend releases backend-39893314723-1-d9bc36aeb69af7f4 (W03, D-Eminence/hid-system#103 at d92b696, deployed 2026-10-23 03:56 UTC with status success for all 12 services), which the seven services other than identity-api still run, and backend-39962729010-1-81ec031fdf82260f (W05b, #107 at ec2b351, 13:48 UTC, identity-api only), which follows W04 (#104 at 15789f7) and W05 (#106 at cd6a71a, backend-39954327263-1-bd2abba54223fd82, 12:45 UTC, identity-api only). Browser-facing changes since identity-api 15789f7: W05 checks the enrollment gate first (availability answers {open:false} while QoreID NIN-only enrollment or its integration is off, and a start answers that gate's 503), lets NIN records without a phone, photo or full address enroll, answers a start's 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED only when its key is for another NIN or an activated registration, shows the new HID again only within 15 minutes of activation, and answers the signed-in POST identity/me/verification/nin with 503 QOREID_PATIENT_NIN_BINDING_DISABLED; W05b adds recordName, the name on the NIN record, to the start answer and, within 15 minutes of the start and never once active, to GET identity/patient-enrollments/current. This frontend shows the gate's closed notice (routes/enrollment/problems.ts registrationClosed), treats the reused key as a completed registration (routes/Enrollment.tsx showCompleted), does not offer the signed-in Verify NIN card (routes/Portal.tsx ProfilePage), and shows recordName under 'NIN verified' until activation (routes/enrollment/RecordName.tsx).
